verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Alerts feature lets users define rules that fire automatically when issues match them. Documented actions include sending notifications, creating tickets, calling webhooks and invoking integrations, and Seer Autofix adds automatic scanning and triage of incoming issues. missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule conditions, filters and thresholds; evidence that rules can be defined programmatically via the API or MCP for AI-native workflows; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations for issues coming from projects or Monitors.
